description:
Some of the most promising AI innovations are not only coming from tech giants. They are also coming from students.

At the #Huawei #ICTCompetition 2025–2026 Global Final, a team of Nigerian students developed ParaVision, an AI-powered diagnostic system designed to detect malaria and parasites in minutes, even without an internet connection.

In this #TransformTalks interview, they share how they built the award-winning solution, what inspired their innovation, and their vision to bring faster, more accessible diagnostics to communities that need them most.

Learn more: https://bit.ly/3SGWSgw #ThisIsHuawei #TECHcares #ICTheFuture
title: Tackling Malaria in Africa with Technology at the Huawei ICT Competition
